details: The upcoming US Consumer Price Index (CPI) report for July, scheduled for August 12, is poised to significantly influence Bitcoin and broader cryptocurrency markets. A softer-than-expected CPI reading could be bullish, potentially easing concerns about further Federal Reserve rate hikes and boosting risk assets. Conversely, if inflation comes in hotter than anticipated, it might revive rate hike expectations, creating a bearish environment for Bitcoin and other risk-sensitive assets. The report's outcome, combined with ongoing diplomatic talks between the United States and Iran that could affect global oil prices and inflation, will be crucial in shaping investor sentiment.
title: How July CPI Report Could Sway Bitcoin & Crypto Markets
